message: Last week, we had a surprise power outage, and my friend Sarah went straight into panic mode. While I was digging out my trusty flashlight and power bank, she was rummaging through her drawers looking for, well, anything that might help! 😂 It reminded me how important it is to have a little emergency kit ready, so when things go dark, I can help keep calm and carry on. Plus, it’s way more fun to light up the night with some good vibes and snacks! What’s your go-to tip for staying cozy during a blackout?
